_readme: Miami-Dade Animal Services adoption info for the Adopt & Foster page. Re-check fees and hours on the MDAS adoption page every few months. To spotlight a specific MDAS dog, add a file in content/dogs/ with source: mdas, animalId and inquiryUrl.
included: Vaccines, microchip, spay/neuter surgery and deworming.

locations.name: Pet Adoption and Protection Center
locations.hours: Mon–Fri 10 AM–6:30 PM · Sat–Sun 9 AM–5 PM

steps: Search online by dog, age, size and gender, and note the Animal ID of any dog you'd like to meet.
Visit the shelter in person. Adoptions happen on site.
Bring a valid ID, proof of address, and a collar and leash.
